title: Global Supply Chains, Geopolitics & Logistics Crisis Management
objective: Menganalisis disrupsi rantai pasok global, embargo dagang, dan manajemen krisis transportasi internasional.

theory.summary: Rantai pasok global (global supply chain) adalah jaringan kompleks yang menghubungkan pemasok, produsen, distributor, dan konsumen di seluruh dunia. Di level B2, Anda perlu menguasai bahasa teknis untuk menganalisis disrupsi seperti embargo dagang, krisis transportasi, dan strategi mitigasi risiko. Modul ini mengajarkan vocabulary spesialis logistik, struktur kalimat untuk risk assessment, serta cara menyampaikan contingency planning dalam konteks bisnis internasional. Anda akan belajar menggunakan conditional sentences untuk skenario krisis, passive voice untuk laporan formal, dan modal verbs untuk rekomendasi strategis.
rules: Gunakan present perfect untuk mendeskripsikan disrupsi yang berdampak hingga sekarang: 'The blockage has disrupted shipping routes for weeks' atau 'Sanctions have severely impacted our procurement process'

Gunakan conditional type 2 dan 3 untuk analisis skenario: 'If the conflict escalated, supply chains would collapse' (hipotesis) atau 'If we had diversified suppliers earlier, we would have avoided this bottleneck' (masa lalu)
Gunakan passive voice dalam laporan formal: 'Alternative routes are being explored' atau 'The embargo was imposed without prior notice' untuk fokus pada tindakan, bukan pelaku
Gunakan modal verbs untuk rekomendasi: 'We should diversify suppliers', 'Companies must implement risk assessment protocols', 'We might need to consider nearshoring strategies'
Gunakan causative structures untuk menjelaskan dampak: 'The trade restrictions have caused delays' atau 'Geopolitical tensions are forcing companies to rethink their strategies'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan Tenses dalam Risk Analysis
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak learner B2 salah menggunakan simple past untuk situasi yang masih berlangsung, atau lupa menggunakan conditional yang tepat saat membahas skenario hipotetis. Dalam konteks supply chain crisis, penting membedakan antara kejadian selesai vs dampak berkelanjutan.
commonTrap.wrong: The sanctions disrupted our supply chain (terlalu sederhana, tidak menunjukkan dampak berkelanjutan)
commonTrap.correct: The sanctions have disrupted our supply chain, and we are still facing significant delays (present perfect + present continuous menunjukkan dampak yang masih berlangsung)

vocab.collocation: The pandemic caused massive disruptions to global supply chains, forcing companies to seek alternative suppliers.
The government imposed a trade embargo on the country, prohibiting all exports of strategic materials.
Port congestion has created a major bottleneck in the distribution network, delaying shipments by weeks.
We need to develop a comprehensive contingency plan to address potential supply chain failures.
Our procurement team is exploring alternative sources to mitigate the risk of supplier dependency.
Economic sanctions have restricted access to key components, forcing manufacturers to redesign products.
Building supply chain resilience requires investment in redundancy and diversification strategies.
Geographic diversification of suppliers can reduce vulnerability to regional disruptions and political instability.
Air freight costs have skyrocketed due to limited capacity and increased demand during the crisis.
Risk mitigation strategies include maintaining buffer inventory and establishing relationships with multiple vendors.

dialogue.context: Sarah, seorang Supply Chain Manager, sedang berdiskusi dengan David, Chief Operations Officer, mengenai dampak ketegangan geopolitik terhadap operasional perusahaan mereka dan strategi mitigasi yang perlu diterapkan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: David, I need to brief you on the latest developments. The trade sanctions imposed last week have severely disrupted our component procurement from Eastern Europe.
lines.translation: David, saya perlu memberi briefing tentang perkembangan terkini. Sanksi perdagangan yang diberlakukan minggu lalu telah sangat mengganggu pengadaan komponen kita dari Eropa Timur.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: How critical is the situation? Are we looking at a complete halt in production, or do we have some buffer inventory to work with?
lines.translation: Seberapa kritis situasinya? Apakah kita menghadapi penghentian produksi total, atau kita punya stok penyangga untuk digunakan?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: We have approximately three weeks of inventory left. I've already activated our contingency plan and reached out to alternative suppliers in Southeast Asia and Latin America.
lines.translation: Kita punya persediaan sekitar tiga minggu lagi. Saya sudah mengaktifkan rencana darurat kita dan menghubungi pemasok alternatif di Asia Tenggara dan Amerika Latin.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Good thinking. What about freight costs? I imagine air freight would be prohibitively expensive given the current capacity constraints.
lines.translation: Pemikiran yang bagus. Bagaimana dengan biaya angkutan? Saya bayangkan angkutan udara akan sangat mahal mengingat keterbatasan kapasitas saat ini.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You're right. Air freight costs have tripled, so I'm proposing a hybrid approach: emergency air shipments for critical components and sea freight for less urgent materials, even though it adds two weeks to lead time.
lines.translation: Anda benar. Biaya angkutan udara naik tiga kali lipat, jadi saya mengusulkan pendekatan hybrid: pengiriman udara darurat untuk komponen kritis dan angkutan laut untuk material yang kurang mendesak, meskipun ini menambah dua minggu waktu tunggu.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: That sounds reasonable. Have you conducted a comprehensive risk assessment for the new suppliers? We can't afford another disruption if these alternatives prove unreliable.
lines.translation: Kedengarannya masuk akal. Sudahkah kamu melakukan penilaian risiko komprehensif untuk pemasok baru? Kita tidak bisa mengalami gangguan lagi jika alternatif ini ternyata tidak dapat diandalkan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Absolutely. I've evaluated their financial stability, production capacity, and geopolitical risk factors. I'm also recommending we maintain relationships with at least three suppliers per critical component moving forward to build greater resilience.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Saya telah mengevaluasi stabilitas keuangan mereka, kapasitas produksi, dan faktor risiko geopolitik. Saya juga merekomendasikan kita mempertahankan hubungan dengan setidaknya tiga pemasok per komponen kritis ke depannya untuk membangun ketahanan yang lebih besar.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Excellent work, Sarah. Please prepare a detailed presentation for the board meeting next Tuesday. They'll want to understand both the immediate mitigation measures and our long-term supply chain diversification strategy.
lines.translation: Kerja yang sangat baik, Sarah. Tolong siapkan presentasi detail untuk rapat dewan Selasa depan. Mereka akan ingin memahami baik langkah-langkah mitigasi segera maupun strategi diversifikasi rantai pasok jangka panjang kita.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang Logistics Coordinator yang sedang melaporkan situasi krisis rantai pasok kepada Mr. Khoirul, yang berperan sebagai Regional Manager. Diskusikan disrupsi yang terjadi, dampaknya terhadap operasional, dan proposal solusi Anda.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning. I understand we're facing some significant supply chain challenges. Can you walk me through the current situation and how it's affecting our operations?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Khoirul. Yes, we've experienced major disruptions due to the port strike in Rotterdam. Our main shipping route has been blocked for ten days now, and we have approximately 40 containers stuck at the terminal.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's concerning. What's the financial impact so far, and have you identified alternative routes? Time is critical here.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The delay has cost us roughly 200,000 euros in penalties and lost sales. I've been negotiating with carriers to reroute through Hamburg and Antwerp, though this will add 5-7 days to our delivery schedule and increase freight costs by about 30 percent.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. What about our customers? Are they aware of the situation, and how are we managing their expectations?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I've already contacted our top 15 clients to inform them of the delays. Most have been understanding, but three major accounts are threatening to switch to competitors if we can't guarantee delivery within two weeks.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: This is a critical situation. What contingency measures are you proposing to prevent similar disruptions in the future?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I recommend we implement a multi-port strategy, diversifying our entry points across at least three major European ports. We should also increase our safety stock levels by 20 percent and establish partnerships with backup carriers to ensure capacity during crises.

quiz.question: The recent political tensions have ___ significant disruptions to international shipping routes, forcing companies to seek alternative transportation methods.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'caused' (present perfect: have caused) karena kalimat mendeskripsikan tindakan di masa lalu yang memiliki dampak berkelanjutan hingga sekarang. 'Been caused' salah karena kita perlu active voice (ketegangan politik yang menyebabkan, bukan disebabkan). 'Causing' tidak cocok dengan struktur 'have' dalam present perfect.

quiz.question: If we ___ our supplier base two years ago, we wouldn't be facing these critical shortages now.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'had diversified' untuk third conditional (conditional type 3) yang membahas situasi hipotesis di masa lalu dengan konsekuensi di masa sekarang. Struktur: If + past perfect, ... would/wouldn't + base verb. Ini menunjukkan penyesalan atas keputusan masa lalu yang tidak diambil.

quiz.question: The logistics team ___ implementing a comprehensive risk assessment protocol to identify potential supply chain vulnerabilities.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'is currently' karena 'team' adalah collective noun yang dianggap singular dalam British English context ini. Adverb 'currently' diletakkan setelah auxiliary verb 'is' dalam present continuous. Struktur: subject + is/are + adverb + verb-ing menunjukkan tindakan yang sedang berlangsung.

quiz.question: Companies must develop ___ to ensure business continuity when facing unexpected trade restrictions or transportation disruptions.
quiz.explanation: Frasa yang benar adalah 'contingency plans' (rencana darurat/kontingensi). 'Contingency' di sini berfungsi sebagai noun modifier yang mendeskripsikan jenis rencana. 'Contingent plans' salah karena 'contingent' adalah adjective yang artinya berbeda (tergantung pada). 'Contingencies plan' salah secara grammar.

quiz.question: The embargo has been ___ for six months, yet many companies still haven't adjusted their procurement strategies accordingly.
quiz.explanation: Idiom yang benar adalah 'in place' yang artinya 'berlaku/diterapkan'. Frasa 'has been in place' dengan present perfect menunjukkan bahwa embargo telah diterapkan dan masih berlaku hingga sekarang. 'In the place' dan 'on place' bukan idiom yang benar dalam konteks ini.
